youtube.title: What if you were a lighthouse keeper on the Flannan Isles?
youtube.description:
December 1900, Eilean Mòr in the Outer Hebrides: the Flannan Isles lighthouse goes dark. 🌊🏝️ A gale keeps the relief boat away for days – and when relief keeper Joseph Moore finally lands, the three keepers are gone. Gate and door shut, beds unmade, the clock stopped, one set of oilskins still hanging inside. The official report blamed a giant wave at the west landing. The creepy logbook entries you may have heard about? A later invention. The men were never found.
What happened to them? A) A giant wave B) Something else C) We will never know – Comment A, B or C 👇
Sources: National Records of Scotland, "The Flannan Islands Lighthouse: a disappearance" (Superintendent Robert Muirhead's report, 8 January 1901, NRS NLC3/1/1); National Records of Scotland research guide "The mystery of the Flannan Islands lighthouse"; History Hit, "Flannan Isle Mystery: When Three Lighthouse Keepers Vanished Forever"; Mike Dash, "True Strange Stories?", Fortean Times (on the invented logbook)
